headline: The $98 correction (6.85% vs 5.625%) is reachable; the same small-bonus labeling problem as task_094 is resolved by a worked example in the stacking-policy document.

issues.summary: The Gold Rewards Card's +0.025% is described both as a credit-card APY bonus (doc_014, doc_045) and as a separate 'relationship bonus APY on top of the base rate' (doc_013); doc_045 also says card bonuses stack with relationship bonuses. doc_013's own example total is corrupted (5.5% + 0.025% shown as 6.0%).
issues.why_it_matters: An agent that treats the 0.025% as a separate relationship bonus adds it on top. doc_045's worked example uses exactly this customer's card set (Gold Rewards, Platinum, EcoCard) and grants only EcoCard's +0.6%, which resolves it toward the gold, so a careful agent reaches the gold.
issues.suggested_fix: Rename doc_013's 0.025% as the Gold Rewards Card credit-card bonus (subject to the highest-only rule) and fix the example total to 5.525%.
evidence: doc_savings_accounts_gold_account_013: "you receive a 0.025% relationship bonus APY on top of the base 5.5% rate" and "Total APY with the bonus: 6.0%"
doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_045 example: Gold Rewards +0.025%, Platinum +0.15%, EcoCard +0.6% -> "The customer receives only the EcoCard bonus of +0.6%"
initial_state credit_card_accounts: Platinum Rewards, Gold Rewards, EcoCard (same set as the doc_045 example)

solution_check: Actual = $450 x 12 / $96,000 = 5.625%, which decomposes as 5.5 + 0.1 (Purple -> Gold, purple_account_001) + 0.025 (Gold Rewards Card). Expected = 5.5 + 0.75 (Green, highest checking boost per doc_046) + 0.6 (EcoCard, highest card bonus per doc_045) = 6.85%. 96,000 x 1.225% / 12 = $98.00. Matches the gold.
prior_note: The prior review rated this Major for the same 0.025% ambiguity; I downgrade to Minor (consistent with task_094) because doc_045's worked example uses this exact card set and explicitly grants only the EcoCard bonus.
notes: If the 0.025% were stacked separately: 6.875% expected and a $100.00 credit. The Silver-vs-Gold Rewards Card mix-up in the user script is resolved by the DB.
